up: Return the IC50 activities for the compound CHEMBL4857685 and any of its related salt forms when tested against the target CHEMBL240 (KCNH2, voltage-gated inwardly rectifying potassium channel). Include the activity details and the compound identifiers.
sql: WITH compound_list AS (SELECT parent.molregno, parent.chembl_id, parent.pref_name FROM molecule_dictionary parent WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4857685' UNION ALL SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id, child.pref_name FROM molecule_dictionary parent JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4857685') SELECT cl.chembl_id, cl.pref_name, a.activity_id, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, ass.description AS assay_description FROM compound_list cl JOIN activities a ON cl.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL240' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' ORDER BY a.standard_value
